_traits_why: 2026-11-20 user: traits must read as Wuxia traits an English speaker gets at once; Chinese jokes and memes replaced by names/lines from each trait's real effect; names fit the ~12-character button. 健康 shows 'HP' as a stat, so the trait row gets 'Healthy'.
_names_why: 2026-11-20: overhead labels join surname + given name with no space (game code); the side panel uses CharacterNameFormat. Every given-name key (random pool + named NPCs with a surname) starts with a space and CharacterNameFormat = {lastname}{firstname}, so both read 'Tang Yi'. Random given names are pinyin (一 = Yi, not the numeral I); surname 山 = Shan. 2026-11-21: characters created before the fix saved their names as plain text without the space ('NiuGuang'), so the panel format has its own space too: {lastname} {firstname}.
